reviews.title: SUCH A W - No ads ever - great community - text based rpg
reviews.text: This is one of those exceedingly rare games where the developers are just genuinely kind people who have a passion for the extensive world they’ve built. If you miss HTML games like gaia online and neopets this captures a similar feeling, so many secrets to explore skills to improve, items to collect, animals to raise, crops to grow and things to craft. It’s the GOAT. Play it now for completely free and decide later if you want to donate to support the game that way, but anything you can buy with real money is reasonably achievable in the game. It’s one of my new favorites for sure. W firestream and the farmrpg team!

reviews.title: Perfectly Balanced FUN
reviews.text:
Whether it’s on an elevator ride, or a quiet morning to just vibe and tap to make some progress, this game is perfect for any amount of time playing.
Good for 60 seconds, good for 60 hours ; there’s always something to do.

Delightfully addictive, for both casual/idle play, and offering a good platform for those heavy grinders who like to min/max everything (that’s me)

What a great game, and I couldn’t recommend it enough.  Come and join for the endlessly satisfying Explore-Craft-Sell-Upgrade cycle, and then just chill & grow with an extremely active and helpful online community.

Big points to the developers for presenting a game that you do NOT have to pay-to-win ; the game offers substantial rewards of premium items , just for doing a good job!

I’m probably only 20% of the way “done” with the game, but it’s exciting to see sneak-peaks for what’s next to unlock.

reviews.title: Fun and Rewarding but Not 100% Voiceover Friendly
reviews.text: I have had a wonderful time leveling up, planting, harvesting, exploring, collecting rewards, and crafting, but not fishing. I have to use gold to fish because I am using Voiceover on my phone and so far I’ve found that doing it manually is impossible. You have to follow the moving circle once you tap on a fish, which is not doable with a screen reader. Everything else is pretty accessible, though, so if this could be fixed or I could receive instructions if I am doing something wrong, it would be just about perfect.

reviews.title: Buggy, laggy, Daily crashing, simp for loot game
reviews.text:
The first few levels are relatively what you would expect for a text based game but once you start getting to higher levels, it requires orders of magnitude more time and energy and actions to complete a level so the developers have created a chat channel for users,  where you can ask for and give items to other people so you essentially need to monitor a chat for items that are given out in a very on structured manner. You can make 500 per day, but you need 50,000+ to gain 
1 Level or you can tap something 50,000,000 million times on your own to achieve the same goal. So most players end up simping for loot.
